name: bleh contrastive orthogonal blend
plain: Extracts what is unique to each of two tensors by subtracting each other's projection, then combines the two parts with a base. A general tool that can act as CFG when a is cond and b comes from the difference. Only the first half of the 116 line function was read.
math:
b⊥=ortho_blend(a,b,b_blend)−a·k_b, then times b_ortho_scale. a⊥=ortho_blend(b,a,a_blend)−b·k_a, then times a_ortho_scale.
b_from_a: b←b·t+a (add) or lerp(a,b,t), so b=uncond with t=−1 when b is (c−u).
Rest (combine, final rescale) not read.
